name: How long does roof leak repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does roof leak repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of roof leak repair depends on the complexity and extent of the damage. Simple repairs, such as replacing a few missing shingles or patching a small hole, can often be completed within a few hours to one day. More extensive repairs involving multiple leak sources, significant structural damage, or large sections of re-roofing might take several days. Weather conditions can also affect the timeline, as roof work cannot safely proceed in heavy rain or high winds.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple repairs may take a few hours to a day, while extensive damage could require several days, depending on complexity and weather.
